description: Verify SHA-256 digest and detached Ed25519 signature of a TITAN statutory workpaper against the published authority public key. Read-only offline cryptographic gate.

authority_pub_b64.description: Optional Base64-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key override (defaults to published TITAN authority key).

canonical_payload.description: Optional UTF-8 canonical JSON payload string to hash and verify against the Ed25519 signature.

query_note.description: Optional non-sensitive context note for audit log labeling.

signature_b64.description: Optional Base64-encoded 64-byte detached Ed25519 signature over canonical_payload.

workpaper_sha256.description: 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the canonical TITAN workpaper artifact.

name: verify_titan_ed25519_workpaper_hash
title: TITAN Ed25519 Cryptographic Workpaper Verifier
